integrity: A uniform exact homotopy-pushout argument and natural integral homology identification prove the unrestricted claim; an independent graph-based program corroborates 54 small graph/threshold combinations and 892 signed character checks.
scientific_limitations: Classification applies to diameter-three double-star trees with both private-leaf sets nonempty. Equivariant result concerns integral homology modules, not an equivariant homotopy splitting. The known four-vertex path special case is not claimed new. Unindexed equivalent literature remains possible.
title: Higher-independence homotopy and automorphism modules of double-star trees
